svg.aria-label: Rev C layout of the EXT board: two 3-way surface-mount PTSM probe sockets on the top edge and a 2-way black 24 VAC entry on the bottom edge, each with its entry face on the board edge, a 2-way white vertical PTSM header for the 5 V output, and the envelopes of the latching plugs outside the edges.

g.text: Rev C, EXT board: surface-mount PTSM headers flush with the edge, component side up, 9 px per mm
Grey: carried over from rev B. Orange: new or moved in rev C. Dashed grey: leaves. Dashed orange: latching plug envelope outside the board.
17.5 between centres, centred on the board
H1, H2 and J3 are PTSM 0,5/n-HH-2,5-SMD headers with the
entry face on the board edge. Rev B's through-hole headers
stood 1.7 mm outside it on one row of pins.
two anchor pads 2.2 x 5.6, 0.8 mm in from the edge
two pegs in 1.1 mm unplated holes, 2.85 mm in
signal pads 1.2 x 3.2 behind the body, ending 9.8 mm in
the body flat on the board over its 7.5 mm depth
Positions, mm from the board's top left
H1 3-way black centre x 10.5 top edge
H2 3-way black centre x 28.0 top edge
J3 2-way black centre x 8.0 bottom edge
J4 2-way white vertical, turned 90, plug stands 18.4
Latching plugs are wider than the header, so the sockets
stand 17.5 mm apart: 1709443 on H1 and H2 (16.8 wide),
beyond the header. The latch is a tooth on each arm in a
window in the header's side wall, 1.2 to 2.1 mm in.
U1, C1, JP1 and R1 stand in one row, 2.5 mm apart and
centred, 2 mm below the header pads.
PF1 is 8 x 3 from x 15.54, y 78.14. C4 sits 3.3 mm left.
H3, U2, C2, JP2 and the tie slots TS1.
J1 GH link, D1-D4, F1, C3, U3, J2 and the title block,
with their nets. The INT board.
J3 and J4 take the same plug
J3 is black and marked 24 VAC; J4 is white and marked
5VDC output only, to Pi, reading upward between C4 and
J4. Print the top copper at 1:1 before ordering.
new or moved in rev C
